jobs.title: Salesforce Operations & Data Quality Specialist
jobs.description: Cprime is an AI-first, human-centered partner, combining strategic consulting with industry-leading platforms to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, and shift enterprise toward AI native thinking. Founded in 2003 and headquartered in the US, our clients span the globe and include more than 300 of the Fortune 500 companies. We bring deep expertise across Atlassian, IBM Apptio, ServiceNow, cloud, data, and enterprise agility to enable intelligent enterprises where people and AI orchestrate as one. Summary: We are seeking a highly detail-oriented Salesforce Operations & Data Quality Specialist to support the integrity, accuracy, and scalability of our licensing and renewal operations. This role will serve as the operational owner for data quality monitoring, exception management, account maintenance, and customer record cleanup across Salesforce and Atlassian PPC systems. What you will do:: Monitor Salesforce error queues and exception-tracking objects. Review and triage data-related issues impacting renewals and licensing processes. Perform manual data corrections to ensure record accuracy and completeness. Identify and remediate duplicate, missing, incomplete, and mismatched renewal records. Maintain account alias mappings for customer-name variations and account matching. Manage customer and billing-profile cleanup efforts across all Cprime accounts within Atlassian PPC. Escalate confirmed system defects and complex issues to the Licensing Technical team with clear documentation. Report on recurring issues, data cleanup progress, trends, and operational metrics. Recommend process improvements that increase data accuracy and reduce manual effort. Required Skills & Qualifications:: 1+ years of experience in Salesforce Operations, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data Quality, Business Operations, or a related field. Experience working with Salesforce data management, reporting, and record maintenance. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Track record of building executive-level relationships and influencing multiple stakeholders across business and technology organizations Excellent presentation, communication, and executive facilitation skills. Preferred Skills (Good to Have):: Experience supporting SaaS, licensing, subscription, or renewal operations. Familiarity with Atlassian products and licensing environments. Salesforce Administrator certification or equivalent experience. What We Believe In At Cprime we believe in facilitating social justice action internally, in industry, and within our communities. We believe part of our mission is to expand the minds, hearts, and opportunities of our Cprime teammates and within the broader community to include those who have been historically marginalized. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement Cprime is an equal-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: GTM AI Operations - India
jobs.description: This opportunity requires that you work a specific shift as this is a region specific role. About JumpCloud® JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times. JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT. What You'll Be Doing:: Reporting to the Sr. Director of Marketing Operations, this role will focus on designing, building, and operationalizing agentic outbound systems that improve pipeline generation efficiency and seller productivity. Core Objectives:: Build Agentic Outbound Systems Design and deploy AI outbound workflows that automate account sourcing, contact acquisition, research, prioritization, personalization, sequencing, and engagement orchestration. Operationalize AI at Scale Move beyond isolated AI experiments by building repeatable, production-ready workflows that integrate across Salesforce, Marketo, Clay, sequencing platforms, enrichment providers, and engagement tools. Improve Outbound Efficiency Reduce manual BDR work through automation while increasing outbound quality, targeting precision, personalization, and activity scalability. Accelerate Pipeline Generation Support the evolution of JumpCloud’s outbound programs through AI targeting, signal-based prioritization, automated enrichment, and intelligent workflow orchestration. Ship Fast and Iterate Rapidly prototype, deploy, measure, and improve GTM workflows with a strong bias toward execution and measurable business impact. We're Looking For:: A highly technical GTM operator who enjoys building systems, automations, and workflows that solve real revenue problems. This person thrives in fast-moving environments, is comfortable working across both strategy and execution, and prefers shipping solutions over discussing hypotheticals. Success in this role is measured by deployed workflows and operational improvements that increase outbound efficiency, pipeline generation, or seller productivity. Required Qualifications:: GTM Systems & Operations Hands-on experience working within modern GTM systems including Salesforce, Marketo, Gong Engage, enrichment providers, and outbound engagement platforms. Experience building and maintaining workflows across tools such as Clay, Openprise, Zapier, Replit, or similar orchestration platforms. Strong understanding of outbound operations, lead/account flows, enrichment strategies, segmentation, and GTM data management. In-depth understanding of how MCPs work and demonstrated experience applying best practices for MCP utilization and efficiency. AI & Automation Practical experience applying AI and automation to GTM workflows beyond experimentation. Experience working with LLMs (preferably Claude Cowork & Code), prompt workflows, structured outputs, AI-assisted personalization, and integrating AI outputs into operational systems. Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, webhooks, and lightweight scripting to connect systems and automate processes. Understanding of concepts such as agentic workflows, signal-based automation, RAG, embeddings, or AI orchestration frameworks is a plus. Builder Mentality Proven ability to independently build and operationalize workflows from idea → deployment → iteration. Comfortable using no-code, low-code, and lightweight coding approaches to deliver solutions quickly. Strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to identify bottlenecks and improve workflow reliability at scale. Cross-Functional Collaboration Ability to partner effectively with Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Data teams to align priorities and execute quickly. Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Operating Style Highly self-directed and execution-oriented with a strong bias toward action. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and iterating quickly as priorities evolve. Motivated by solving operational problems and building systems that create measurable business impact. Shift Availability:: This role will align with an EMEA shift schedule, roughy 1:00pm - 10:00 pm IST #LI-YA1 Where you’ll be working/Location: JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role. Language: JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description. Why JumpCloud®? If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about. One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time. JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Scam Notice: Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment. All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice" #LI-Remote #BI-Remote

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst - Customer Experience & Partner Operations
jobs.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Build the operating backbone for Customer Experience and Partnerships by ensuring our processes, systems, and data work together seamlessly. You’ll own the instrumentation of key workflows in HubSpot, establish reliable metrics and reporting, maintain operational hygiene, and turn GTM data into clear insights for the teams making decisions. The goal is simple: make CS and Partnerships easier to operate, easier to measure, and easier to scale. Where you'll leave your mark?: Own the Customer Success Operations including CX process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of CX processes, workflows and process adherence Owning of key metrics definition and periodic (Weekly, monthly, quarterly) reporting including renewal, retention, upsells, GDR, NDR, Logo retention Own the Partnership Operations including Partnership process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of Partnership processes, workflows and process adherence Build and maintain partner pipeline and program reporting Support recurring GTM operations requests across both CS and Partnerships including variable pay calculations, adhoc data requests The kind of builder we're looking for -: 3-5 years of experience in Revenue Operations preferably in Customer Success and/or Partnership Operations Hands-on experience with Hubspot including building workflows, properties, reports and dashboards Working fluency in SaaS metrics - ARR, MRR, GDR, NDR, Churn, Partner sourced and Partner influenced ARR Demonstrated experience in maintaining data hygiene and catching errors / process deviances Ability to learn new AI tools, technologies and processes Strong attention to detail and ability to collaborate effectively with various stakeholders How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

Develop advanced reporting solutions, including joined reports, complex filters, and multidimensional data analysis. Monitor and report on pipeline performance, forecasting accuracy, renewals, sales productivity, conversion rates, and revenue KPIs. Analyze sales trends, funnel performance, and forecast attainment to identify opportunities and recommend improvements. Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate reporting needs into scalable, reliable Salesforce solutions. Maintain data integrity across Salesforce Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, and Forecasting objects. Conduct regular data audits, investigate discrepancies, and improve the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of reporting. Establish and promote CRM data governance standards and best practices. Support forecasting, pipeline management, territory planning, quota management, and other sales operations initiatives. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance teams to align reporting frameworks, definitions, and performance metrics. Identify opportunities to streamline reporting workflows and continuously improve sales operations processes. Advanced hands-on expertise in creating and managing Salesforce reports, custom report types, dashboards, joined reports, scheduled reports, and complex reporting filters. Strong understanding of Salesforce data structures, standard objects, relationships, and reporting capabilities. Experience supporting sales forecasting, pipeline analysis, and performance reporting. Advanced Excel skills, including data analysis, data manipulation, and reporting. High attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy, consistency, and quality. Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and contribute effectively in a collaborative environment. Strong understanding of audience segmentation, suppression lists, marketing automation workflows, and campaign management practices. Demonstrated reporting and analytical skills, including experience developing campaign performance reports and conducting trend analysis. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, with the ability to organize, analyze, and interpret marketing data accurately. Strong attention to detail and a quality-focused approach to campaign setup, data management, testing, and reporting. needs_verification.description: Accountabilities:: As a Project Management Associate, you will support end-to-end project delivery by managing data workflows, maintaining reporting accuracy, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure successful customer implementations. Your responsibilities will include: Data Analysis and Excel-Based Calculations: Process raw AI-generated outputs and transform them into accurate, customer-ready insights using advanced Excel functions, including VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, conditional logic, and complex formulas. Dataset Management: Analyze, organize, and reconcile large, multi-sheet datasets containing quantitative performance metrics and qualitative store execution information. ROI Analysis and Reporting: Translate project delivery metrics into measurable return-on-investment figures by applying business logic and validating calculations. Project Operations and Onboarding: Take ownership of assigned tasks within customer onboarding, ensuring data feeds, reporting processes, and operational requirements are completed accurately and on time. Task and Deadline Management: Coordinate multiple project components simultaneously, prioritize competing responsibilities, and meet deadlines across different customer engagements. Operational Ownership: Independently manage defined project activities from initiation through completion, ensuring reliable execution within your area of responsibility. Quality Assurance: Maintain rigorous quality control over datasets, calculations, and reports to ensure accuracy, consistency, and data integrity before sharing results with customers. Problem-Solving and Process Improvement: Identify potential roadblocks in data processing workflows, investigate operational issues, and proactively recommend solutions before problems escalate. Product Knowledge and Implementation Support: Develop a strong understanding of the product to troubleshoot operational challenges and support tailored solutions for customer-specific requirements. Cross-Functional Coordination: Work with Data Operations, Engineering, and Project Managers to resolve data issues, coordinate information flow, and keep projects progressing efficiently. Presentations and Stakeholder Communication: Help prepare professional, customer-facing presentations that communicate analytical findings, project performance, and actionable insights. Support presentations to internal teams and, occasionally, customers. Requirements: The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and proactive, with strong Excel skills and a willingness to take responsibility for project outcomes. The following qualifications and capabilities are expected: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including lookup functions, pivot tables, conditional logic, and the ability to build, troubleshoot, and maintain complex calculation models. Ability to work confidently with large datasets containing both numerical metrics and descriptive information, using Excel to manipulate, reconcile, and synthesize data. A high level of personal accountability, with a commitment to delivering accurate, reliable work within agreed deadlines. A proactive, action-oriented mindset, including the ability to identify process improvements, ask clarifying questions, and move tasks forward independently. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and develop practical solutions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain findings clearly and collaborate with different teams. Good organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Adaptability, enthusiasm for technology, and eagerness to learn new tools and processes. A degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Data Science, or a related field is preferred. A project management certification, or current enrollment in a relevant certification program, is an advantage. Previous experience demonstrating initiative and ownership through internships, academic projects, extracurricular activities, or professional responsibilities is beneficial. Familiarity with business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Zoho Analytics is helpful. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement. Full-time employment with an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in AI-powered retail technology. Practical exposure to project management, customer success, data analytics, and business intelligence. Opportunities to develop advanced Excel skills and gain experience with reporting and analytical tools. Cross-functional collaboration with Data Operations, Engineering, and project delivery teams. needs_verification.title: Salesforce Admin with CPQ , LAO and Order Management
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Administer and maintain Salesforce environments, applying a strong understanding of Salesforce concepts, architecture, and platform capabilities. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, and service, to understand business needs and implement effective Salesforce solutions. Configure and manage Salesforce functionality, including workflows, Process Builder, Flows, assignment rules, approval processes, fields, page layouts, record types, dynamic layouts, apps, actions, custom settings, and custom metadata. Create, maintain, and optimize custom reports and dashboards to support sales teams and executive decision-making. Develop and implement data management strategies, including data cleansing and validation rules, to maintain data accuracy, consistency, and completeness. Apply Salesforce administration best practices to maximize platform uptime, improve data quality, and optimize system response times. Stay informed about Salesforce releases, new features, and industry best practices, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement. Proactively identify system enhancement opportunities and lead the implementation of new functionalities that support operational efficiency and business growth. Support deployments and migrations using tools such as Salesforce DX, CI/CD, Force.com IDE, VS Code, ANT, and Copado. Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and support to other Salesforce administrators. Requirements: Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Salesforce Administration, with an overall experience range of 5–12 years. Strong hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator, supported by a solid understanding of Salesforce concepts, architecture, and platform capabilities. Practical expertise in Salesforce configuration, including workflows, Process Builder, Flows, assignment rules, approval processes, page layouts, record types, custom settings, and custom metadata. Experience creating and maintaining custom reports and dashboards for sales and executive stakeholders. Strong understanding of data management practices, including data cleansing, data validation, and maintaining data integrity. Experience with Salesforce deployment and migration tools, including Salesforce DX, CI/CD, Force.com IDE, VS Code, ANT, and Copado. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and translate business requirements into practical Salesforce solutions. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to system enhancements. Ability to provide technical guidance and mentorship within a collaborative team environment. Salesforce Administrator and Advanced Administrator certifications are preferred. Benefits: Remote work arrangement. Full-time employment. Opportunity to contribute to Salesforce platform improvements and business process optimization. Opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams and support technical knowledge-sharing. needs_verification.title: Associate Travel & Expense
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Travel & Expense Platform Administration: Manage and maintain the SAP Concur Travel & Expense platform, including audit rule configuration, user administration, workflow maintenance, and routine system support to ensure reliable and efficient operations. Expense Auditing and Compliance: Review and audit employee expense reports in SAP Concur to verify compliance with travel policies, expense guidelines, and internal financial controls. Identify discrepancies, investigate exceptions, and ensure accurate and timely reimbursement processing. Corporate Card Administration: Manage the corporate card programme, including card issuance, ordering, deactivation, and monitoring of overdue balances. Ensure appropriate card usage and compliance with established policies and procedures. Workflow and Transaction Management: Monitor Concur workflows, including unassigned and unapproved transactions, and coordinate necessary follow-ups to ensure timely processing. Support month-end activities by preparing accrual reports and monitoring outstanding expenses. Vendor Master Data Management: Create, update, and maintain supplier records in SAP, ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of vendor information and supporting documentation. Supplier Documentation Validation: Review and validate supplier documentation, including tax forms, banking details, and other required records, before creating or modifying vendor master data. Issue Resolution and Stakeholder Support: Investigate and resolve complex travel expense, corporate card, and vendor data inquiries. Collaborate with employees, Accounts Payable, purchasing teams, business stakeholders, and external suppliers to address discrepancies and implement effective solutions. External Service Provider Coordination: Work with SAP Concur support teams, corporate card providers, and travel service partners to resolve technical issues, improve service delivery, and maintain efficient operational processes. Financial Reporting and Analysis: Prepare and analyse weekly and monthly operational reports for management. Monitor key performance indicators, identify trends, and provide accurate information to support decision-making and process improvement. Internal Controls and Financial Governance: Support the execution of internal controls across expense processing, corporate card administration, and vendor master maintenance. Maintain appropriate documentation and ensure adherence to financial governance requirements. Employee Training and Guidance: Provide training and onboarding support for new employees using the expense management platform. Assist existing employees with system queries, expense policies, and workflow-related questions. Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve expense management, supplier data maintenance, reporting accuracy, and workflow efficiency. Support standardisation and continuous improvement initiatives across finance operations. Requirements Education: A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline. Professional Experience: Ideally 5–8 years of relevant experience in Travel & Expense management, Accounts Payable, Vendor Master Data, Finance Operations, or Procure-to-Pay processes, preferably within a shared services centre or multinational organisation. SAP Concur Expertise: Strong functional and technical knowledge of SAP Concur Expense administration, expense auditing, workflow management, user support, and corporate card programme operations. SAP ERP Knowledge: Practical experience with SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA, particularly vendor master data creation, maintenance, validation, and supplier information management. Travel and Expense Compliance: Strong understanding of travel and expense policies, reimbursement procedures, corporate card controls, expense compliance requirements, and financial governance practices. Vendor Master Data Management: Experience validating supplier documentation, maintaining accurate vendor records, reviewing banking and tax information, and resolving supplier data discrepancies. Financial Operations Knowledge: Familiarity with Accounts Payable, Procure-to-Pay workflows, month-end closing activities, accrual reporting, reconciliations, and operational reporting. Advanced Excel Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, data analysis, reporting, and reconciliation of large datasets. Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong attention to detail and the ability to investigate exceptions, identify root causes, analyse financial data, and resolve operational issues efficiently. Communication and Customer Service: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to support employees, respond to queries, explain policies, and coordinate effectively with internal and external stakeholders. Training and Stakeholder Management: Ability to guide users, deliver system training, manage stakeholder expectations, and maintain productive working relationships across multiple departments. Organisation and Time Management: Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, handle multiple requests, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced financial operations environment. needs_verification.title: Specialist - Process Analytics - Claims & Underwriting 4B
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities:: As a Process Analytics Specialist, you will manage portfolio analytics and catastrophe modeling activities, ensuring accurate exposure data, reliable modeling outputs, and timely delivery of analytical results. You will apply your understanding of reinsurance structures and risk modeling systems to investigate data variations and generate insights that support effective risk management. Manage Treaty and Facultative Submissions: Review and interpret treaty and facultative (FAC) submissions, ensuring relevant information is accurately captured and applied during portfolio modeling. Update Risk Modeling Accounts: Create, update, and model accounts within RMS RiskLink/AIR, incorporating the appropriate treaty information, terms, and conditions. Process Portfolio Exposure Data: Import and validate portfolio exposure summaries, run catastrophe models, and analyze results to identify relevant risk insights. Investigate Exposure Variations: Perform EDM reconciliations to determine the causes of differences between current and previous portfolio exposure results. Develop and Execute SQL Scripts: Create, modify, and run SQL scripts to support routine processing activities, data validation, reconciliation, and analytical workflows. Generate Risk Management Insights: Analyze client data and modeling outputs to identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities to improve risk assessment and portfolio management. Maintain Data Accuracy: Apply rigorous validation and analytical practices to ensure data integrity and reliable catastrophe modeling results. Meet Delivery Deadlines: Complete assigned tasks within established timelines while maintaining accuracy and productivity, particularly during monthly portfolio roll-up cycles. Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with colleagues and stakeholders to resolve analytical issues, share findings, and support efficient portfolio processing. Support Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to coaching and mentoring activities, helping colleagues strengthen their technical skills and understanding of portfolio analytics processes. Improve Operational Efficiency: Identify opportunities to refine day-to-day workflows and enhance the speed, quality, and consistency of analytical delivery. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines practical experience in portfolio analytics and catastrophe modeling with strong technical skills in risk modeling systems, SQL, and Excel. You should be comfortable interpreting complex insurance data, troubleshooting discrepancies, and delivering accurate results under pressure. Professional Experience: 3–5 years of experience in portfolio analytics, catastrophe modeling, or a closely related field. Catastrophe Modeling Expertise: Demonstrated experience with catastrophe models is essential, including the ability to interpret modeling outputs and assess portfolio exposure results. RMS RiskLink/AIR Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of RMS RiskLink/AIR and its backend data schema, including account modeling and portfolio processing. Treaty Modeling Knowledge: Understanding of reinsurance treaty modeling, treaty terms and conditions, and facultative submissions. SQL Skills: Proficiency in writing, modifying, and executing SQL queries and scripts to support data processing, reconciliation, and validation. Microsoft Excel Expertise: Advanced Excel skills, including familiarity with macros and spreadsheet-based analysis. Data Reconciliation and Analysis: Strong analytical capabilities and attention to detail, with the ability to investigate data discrepancies and identify the underlying causes of exposure variations. Academic Qualifications: A bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Computer Science, or Statistics, or a master's degree in Data Science, is relevant to the role. Time Management: Ability to prioritize workloads, deliver time-sensitive tasks, and maintain quality during demanding monthly portfolio roll-up cycles. Problem-Solving Skills: Strong critical thinking and troubleshooting abilities, with a proactive approach to resolving technical and data-related challenges. Communication Skills: Good written and verbal English communication skills, with an indicated proficiency level of B1 or intermediate. Teamwork and Motivation: Ability to collaborate effectively, demonstrate initiative, and maintain a high level of motivation in a fast-paced environment. Execution and Adaptability: Strong execution speed, flexibility, and the ability to manage work pressure while meeting operational requirements. Coaching and Mentoring: Ability to share knowledge and support the development of other team members. Relevant Certifications: Insurance-related certifications may be beneficial, although specific certifications are not clearly established as mandatory in the posting. Benefits: Remote Work: Fully remote position based in India. Flexible Schedule: Flex-time working arrangements aligned with business requirements. Career Development: Opportunities to expand technical expertise and progress professionally through hands-on experience and challenging assignments. Learning and Mentorship: Access to learning opportunities, mentoring, and professional development. Meaningful Business Impact: Contribute to risk analytics and catastrophe modeling activities that support major enterprise clients. Advanced Technology Exposure: Work with specialized catastrophe modeling systems, SQL, Excel, and data analytics processes. Collaborative Culture: Join a team-oriented environment that values innovation, integrity, curiosity, inclusion, and continuous improvement. Inclusive Workplace: Equal employment opportunity and a commitment to a respectful, diverse working environment. needs_verification.title: Amazon Catalog Specialist
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Manage Amazon product catalogs: Create, update, and maintain product listings across Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central, ensuring accurate product information, consistent content, and compliance with platform requirements. Troubleshoot catalog issues: Identify and resolve suppressed listings, detail page errors, stranded inventory, listing conflicts, and parent-child variation inconsistencies to maintain catalog health. Optimize listing content: Improve product titles, bullet points, descriptions, images, and other listing elements to strengthen search visibility, enhance the customer experience, and increase conversion potential. Manage product variations: Build, maintain, and audit parent-child relationships across catalogs, proactively identifying structural inconsistencies and correcting issues before they affect product discoverability or customer experience. Execute bulk catalog updates: Prepare, validate, and upload Amazon flat files and bulk templates to implement large-scale catalog changes efficiently while maintaining data accuracy. Coordinate with Amazon Support: Open, track, and manage support cases and work with Brand Registry to resolve listing conflicts, correct catalog information, and enforce brand content requirements. Conduct catalog audits: Regularly review product detail pages to identify content gaps, compliance risks, optimization opportunities, and inconsistencies across product listings. Improve listing performance: Plan and execute A/B tests on product content, analyze results, and implement data-driven changes to improve listing effectiveness. Conduct product and market research: Use Amazon Product Opportunity Explorer to assess keywords, niches, competitor activity, product features, customer reviews, and return-related insights to inform catalog optimization. Monitor organic ranking performance: Use Smart Scout and other approved research tools to evaluate keyword rankings and measure the impact of listing changes. Support promotional campaigns: Execute Amazon promotional campaigns and monitor their effects on product visibility and performance. Maintain reporting and documentation: Update sales trackers, catalog health reports, internal spreadsheets, and client-facing records to communicate progress, optimization results, and outstanding issues. Manage multiple catalogs independently: Handle catalogs of varying sizes, including those containing hundreds or thousands of SKUs, prioritize tasks effectively, and complete assignments accurately within agreed deadlines. Communicate and escalate effectively: Document issues and solutions clearly, provide timely updates, and seek clarification or escalate complex problems when necessary. Meet agreed service deliverables: Perform all assigned services professionally and in accordance with the written scope of work, agreed timelines, and applicable client requirements. Requirements: Amazon platform experience: At least one year of hands-on experience with Amazon Vendor Central and at least one year with Amazon Seller Central. Catalog management expertise: Proven experience troubleshooting Amazon listing issues, managing product detail pages, resolving suppressed listings, and maintaining accurate catalog structures. Bulk upload proficiency: Practical experience preparing and uploading Amazon flat files, using bulk templates, and implementing large-scale catalog updates with a high degree of accuracy. Variation management: Strong understanding of parent-child relationships, variation themes, catalog structures, and common variation-related issues. Amazon support and compliance: Experience managing Amazon Support cases and working with Brand Registry, alongside a solid understanding of Amazon listing guidelines, content policies, and compliance requirements. Listing optimization and testing: Experience optimizing product content and conducting A/B tests, with the ability to interpret results and translate findings into actionable improvements. Research and analytics: Familiarity with Amazon Product Opportunity Explorer and the ability to analyze organic ranking performance, competitor activity, product features, customer reviews, and return-related insights. Reporting and productivity tools: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, along with Google Workspace tools such as Gmail, Tasks, Keep Notes, and other relevant productivity applications. Promotional campaign experience: Familiarity with Amazon promotional campaigns and the ability to assess their impact on product performance. Attention to detail: Strong organizational skills and the ability to maintain accurate product data across multiple listings, catalogs, and competing priorities. Independent execution: Ability to work from task lists, manage assignments without continuous supervision, meet deadlines, and recognize when additional guidance is required. Communication skills: Clear written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to document catalog issues, explain solutions, and provide timely progress updates. Preferred experience: Background in catalog audits, SEO-driven listing optimization, agency or multi-brand environments, and managing multiple client catalogs. Additional preferred tools: Experience with Smart Scout for product and organic ranking analysis, Keepa for product and Buy Box monitoring, and research tools that support large-scale Amazon catalog optimization. Professional approach: A proactive, analytical, and solutions-oriented mindset, with the ability to adapt to different client requirements and product volumes. Work arrangement and schedule: Remote independent contractor opportunity open to candidates based in Poland. Contracted workload of approximately 20 hours per week . Standard schedule: Monday through Friday, from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM Eastern Time (ET) , subject to mutual agreement and scheduling requirements. One contractor will be assigned to the engagement. English is the required working language. A neutral accent is preferred, but no gender preference applies. The assigned contact person and reporting arrangements will be confirmed during the engagement process. Benefits: Competitive rates: Compensation based on the terms of the independent contractor engagement. Weekly payments: Regular weekly payment processing through the contracting platform, according to the agreed terms. Flexible remote work: Work remotely while supporting international e-commerce clients. Part-time commitment: A defined 20-hour weekly schedule that may offer flexibility alongside other professional commitments. Training and upskilling: Access to free training opportunities designed to develop professional capabilities and expand e-commerce expertise. Ongoing support: Guidance and assistance throughout the engagement to help contractors complete assignments successfully. Professional community: Access to a supportive community of virtual assistants and independent professionals. Additional opportunities: Exposure to a range of potential client engagements and e-commerce-related roles, depending on availability and qualifications. International experience: The opportunity to strengthen Amazon marketplace expertise while working with clients in global markets. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). strong_shortlist.title: Salesforce Operations & Data Quality Specialist
strong_shortlist.description: Cprime is an AI-first, human-centered partner, combining strategic consulting with industry-leading platforms to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, and shift enterprise toward AI native thinking. Founded in 2003 and headquartered in the US, our clients span the globe and include more than 300 of the Fortune 500 companies. We bring deep expertise across Atlassian, IBM Apptio, ServiceNow, cloud, data, and enterprise agility to enable intelligent enterprises where people and AI orchestrate as one. Summary: We are seeking a highly detail-oriented Salesforce Operations & Data Quality Specialist to support the integrity, accuracy, and scalability of our licensing and renewal operations. This role will serve as the operational owner for data quality monitoring, exception management, account maintenance, and customer record cleanup across Salesforce and Atlassian PPC systems. What you will do:: Monitor Salesforce error queues and exception-tracking objects. Review and triage data-related issues impacting renewals and licensing processes. Perform manual data corrections to ensure record accuracy and completeness. Identify and remediate duplicate, missing, incomplete, and mismatched renewal records. Maintain account alias mappings for customer-name variations and account matching. Manage customer and billing-profile cleanup efforts across all Cprime accounts within Atlassian PPC. Escalate confirmed system defects and complex issues to the Licensing Technical team with clear documentation. Report on recurring issues, data cleanup progress, trends, and operational metrics. Recommend process improvements that increase data accuracy and reduce manual effort. Required Skills & Qualifications:: 1+ years of experience in Salesforce Operations, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data Quality, Business Operations, or a related field. Experience working with Salesforce data management, reporting, and record maintenance. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Track record of building executive-level relationships and influencing multiple stakeholders across business and technology organizations Excellent presentation, communication, and executive facilitation skills. Preferred Skills (Good to Have):: Experience supporting SaaS, licensing, subscription, or renewal operations. Familiarity with Atlassian products and licensing environments. Salesforce Administrator certification or equivalent experience. What We Believe In At Cprime we believe in facilitating social justice action internally, in industry, and within our communities. We believe part of our mission is to expand the minds, hearts, and opportunities of our Cprime teammates and within the broader community to include those who have been historically marginalized. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement Cprime is an equal-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

strong_shortlist.title: GTM AI Operations - India
strong_shortlist.description: This opportunity requires that you work a specific shift as this is a region specific role. About JumpCloud® JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times. JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT. What You'll Be Doing:: Reporting to the Sr. Director of Marketing Operations, this role will focus on designing, building, and operationalizing agentic outbound systems that improve pipeline generation efficiency and seller productivity. Core Objectives:: Build Agentic Outbound Systems Design and deploy AI outbound workflows that automate account sourcing, contact acquisition, research, prioritization, personalization, sequencing, and engagement orchestration. Operationalize AI at Scale Move beyond isolated AI experiments by building repeatable, production-ready workflows that integrate across Salesforce, Marketo, Clay, sequencing platforms, enrichment providers, and engagement tools. Improve Outbound Efficiency Reduce manual BDR work through automation while increasing outbound quality, targeting precision, personalization, and activity scalability. Accelerate Pipeline Generation Support the evolution of JumpCloud’s outbound programs through AI targeting, signal-based prioritization, automated enrichment, and intelligent workflow orchestration. Ship Fast and Iterate Rapidly prototype, deploy, measure, and improve GTM workflows with a strong bias toward execution and measurable business impact. We're Looking For:: A highly technical GTM operator who enjoys building systems, automations, and workflows that solve real revenue problems. This person thrives in fast-moving environments, is comfortable working across both strategy and execution, and prefers shipping solutions over discussing hypotheticals. Success in this role is measured by deployed workflows and operational improvements that increase outbound efficiency, pipeline generation, or seller productivity. Required Qualifications:: GTM Systems & Operations Hands-on experience working within modern GTM systems including Salesforce, Marketo, Gong Engage, enrichment providers, and outbound engagement platforms. Experience building and maintaining workflows across tools such as Clay, Openprise, Zapier, Replit, or similar orchestration platforms. Strong understanding of outbound operations, lead/account flows, enrichment strategies, segmentation, and GTM data management. In-depth understanding of how MCPs work and demonstrated experience applying best practices for MCP utilization and efficiency. AI & Automation Practical experience applying AI and automation to GTM workflows beyond experimentation. Experience working with LLMs (preferably Claude Cowork & Code), prompt workflows, structured outputs, AI-assisted personalization, and integrating AI outputs into operational systems. Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, webhooks, and lightweight scripting to connect systems and automate processes. Understanding of concepts such as agentic workflows, signal-based automation, RAG, embeddings, or AI orchestration frameworks is a plus. Builder Mentality Proven ability to independently build and operationalize workflows from idea → deployment → iteration. Comfortable using no-code, low-code, and lightweight coding approaches to deliver solutions quickly. Strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to identify bottlenecks and improve workflow reliability at scale. Cross-Functional Collaboration Ability to partner effectively with Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Data teams to align priorities and execute quickly. Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Operating Style Highly self-directed and execution-oriented with a strong bias toward action. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and iterating quickly as priorities evolve. Motivated by solving operational problems and building systems that create measurable business impact. Shift Availability:: This role will align with an EMEA shift schedule, roughy 1:00pm - 10:00 pm IST #LI-YA1 Where you’ll be working/Location: JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role. Language: JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description. Why JumpCloud®? If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about. One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time. JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Scam Notice: Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment. All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice" #LI-Remote #BI-Remote

strong_shortlist.title: Revenue Operations Analyst - Customer Experience & Partner Operations
strong_shortlist.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Build the operating backbone for Customer Experience and Partnerships by ensuring our processes, systems, and data work together seamlessly. You’ll own the instrumentation of key workflows in HubSpot, establish reliable metrics and reporting, maintain operational hygiene, and turn GTM data into clear insights for the teams making decisions. The goal is simple: make CS and Partnerships easier to operate, easier to measure, and easier to scale. Where you'll leave your mark?: Own the Customer Success Operations including CX process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of CX processes, workflows and process adherence Owning of key metrics definition and periodic (Weekly, monthly, quarterly) reporting including renewal, retention, upsells, GDR, NDR, Logo retention Own the Partnership Operations including Partnership process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of Partnership processes, workflows and process adherence Build and maintain partner pipeline and program reporting Support recurring GTM operations requests across both CS and Partnerships including variable pay calculations, adhoc data requests The kind of builder we're looking for -: 3-5 years of experience in Revenue Operations preferably in Customer Success and/or Partnership Operations Hands-on experience with Hubspot including building workflows, properties, reports and dashboards Working fluency in SaaS metrics - ARR, MRR, GDR, NDR, Churn, Partner sourced and Partner influenced ARR Demonstrated experience in maintaining data hygiene and catching errors / process deviances Ability to learn new AI tools, technologies and processes Strong attention to detail and ability to collaborate effectively with various stakeholders How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

review_queue.title: Project Management Associate
review_queue.description: Accountabilities:: As a Project Management Associate, you will support end-to-end project delivery by managing data workflows, maintaining reporting accuracy, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure successful customer implementations. Your responsibilities will include: Data Analysis and Excel-Based Calculations: Process raw AI-generated outputs and transform them into accurate, customer-ready insights using advanced Excel functions, including VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, conditional logic, and complex formulas. Dataset Management: Analyze, organize, and reconcile large, multi-sheet datasets containing quantitative performance metrics and qualitative store execution information. ROI Analysis and Reporting: Translate project delivery metrics into measurable return-on-investment figures by applying business logic and validating calculations. Project Operations and Onboarding: Take ownership of assigned tasks within customer onboarding, ensuring data feeds, reporting processes, and operational requirements are completed accurately and on time. Task and Deadline Management: Coordinate multiple project components simultaneously, prioritize competing responsibilities, and meet deadlines across different customer engagements. Operational Ownership: Independently manage defined project activities from initiation through completion, ensuring reliable execution within your area of responsibility. Quality Assurance: Maintain rigorous quality control over datasets, calculations, and reports to ensure accuracy, consistency, and data integrity before sharing results with customers. Problem-Solving and Process Improvement: Identify potential roadblocks in data processing workflows, investigate operational issues, and proactively recommend solutions before problems escalate. Product Knowledge and Implementation Support: Develop a strong understanding of the product to troubleshoot operational challenges and support tailored solutions for customer-specific requirements. Cross-Functional Coordination: Work with Data Operations, Engineering, and Project Managers to resolve data issues, coordinate information flow, and keep projects progressing efficiently. Presentations and Stakeholder Communication: Help prepare professional, customer-facing presentations that communicate analytical findings, project performance, and actionable insights. Support presentations to internal teams and, occasionally, customers. Requirements: The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and proactive, with strong Excel skills and a willingness to take responsibility for project outcomes. The following qualifications and capabilities are expected: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including lookup functions, pivot tables, conditional logic, and the ability to build, troubleshoot, and maintain complex calculation models. Ability to work confidently with large datasets containing both numerical metrics and descriptive information, using Excel to manipulate, reconcile, and synthesize data. A high level of personal accountability, with a commitment to delivering accurate, reliable work within agreed deadlines. A proactive, action-oriented mindset, including the ability to identify process improvements, ask clarifying questions, and move tasks forward independently. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and develop practical solutions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain findings clearly and collaborate with different teams. Good organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Adaptability, enthusiasm for technology, and eagerness to learn new tools and processes. A degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Data Science, or a related field is preferred. A project management certification, or current enrollment in a relevant certification program, is an advantage. Previous experience demonstrating initiative and ownership through internships, academic projects, extracurricular activities, or professional responsibilities is beneficial. Familiarity with business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Zoho Analytics is helpful. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement. Full-time employment with an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in AI-powered retail technology. Practical exposure to project management, customer success, data analytics, and business intelligence. Opportunities to develop advanced Excel skills and gain experience with reporting and analytical tools. Cross-functional collaboration with Data Operations, Engineering, and project delivery teams. Opportunities to take ownership of meaningful projects and develop problem-solving and stakeholder management skills. Exposure to international customers and customer-facing project delivery. Scheduled working hours from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM. How Jobgether works: We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. #LI-CL1

review_queue.title: Associate Travel & Expense
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Travel & Expense Platform Administration: Manage and maintain the SAP Concur Travel & Expense platform, including audit rule configuration, user administration, workflow maintenance, and routine system support to ensure reliable and efficient operations. Expense Auditing and Compliance: Review and audit employee expense reports in SAP Concur to verify compliance with travel policies, expense guidelines, and internal financial controls. Identify discrepancies, investigate exceptions, and ensure accurate and timely reimbursement processing. Corporate Card Administration: Manage the corporate card programme, including card issuance, ordering, deactivation, and monitoring of overdue balances. Ensure appropriate card usage and compliance with established policies and procedures. Workflow and Transaction Management: Monitor Concur workflows, including unassigned and unapproved transactions, and coordinate necessary follow-ups to ensure timely processing. Support month-end activities by preparing accrual reports and monitoring outstanding expenses. Vendor Master Data Management: Create, update, and maintain supplier records in SAP, ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of vendor information and supporting documentation. Supplier Documentation Validation: Review and validate supplier documentation, including tax forms, banking details, and other required records, before creating or modifying vendor master data. Issue Resolution and Stakeholder Support: Investigate and resolve complex travel expense, corporate card, and vendor data inquiries. Collaborate with employees, Accounts Payable, purchasing teams, business stakeholders, and external suppliers to address discrepancies and implement effective solutions. External Service Provider Coordination: Work with SAP Concur support teams, corporate card providers, and travel service partners to resolve technical issues, improve service delivery, and maintain efficient operational processes. Financial Reporting and Analysis: Prepare and analyse weekly and monthly operational reports for management. Monitor key performance indicators, identify trends, and provide accurate information to support decision-making and process improvement. Internal Controls and Financial Governance: Support the execution of internal controls across expense processing, corporate card administration, and vendor master maintenance. Maintain appropriate documentation and ensure adherence to financial governance requirements. Employee Training and Guidance: Provide training and onboarding support for new employees using the expense management platform. Assist existing employees with system queries, expense policies, and workflow-related questions. Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve expense management, supplier data maintenance, reporting accuracy, and workflow efficiency. Support standardisation and continuous improvement initiatives across finance operations. Requirements Education: A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline. Professional Experience: Ideally 5–8 years of relevant experience in Travel & Expense management, Accounts Payable, Vendor Master Data, Finance Operations, or Procure-to-Pay processes, preferably within a shared services centre or multinational organisation. SAP Concur Expertise: Strong functional and technical knowledge of SAP Concur Expense administration, expense auditing, workflow management, user support, and corporate card programme operations. SAP ERP Knowledge: Practical experience with SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA, particularly vendor master data creation, maintenance, validation, and supplier information management. Travel and Expense Compliance: Strong understanding of travel and expense policies, reimbursement procedures, corporate card controls, expense compliance requirements, and financial governance practices. Vendor Master Data Management: Experience validating supplier documentation, maintaining accurate vendor records, reviewing banking and tax information, and resolving supplier data discrepancies. Financial Operations Knowledge: Familiarity with Accounts Payable, Procure-to-Pay workflows, month-end closing activities, accrual reporting, reconciliations, and operational reporting. Advanced Excel Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, data analysis, reporting, and reconciliation of large datasets. Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong attention to detail and the ability to investigate exceptions, identify root causes, analyse financial data, and resolve operational issues efficiently. Communication and Customer Service: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to support employees, respond to queries, explain policies, and coordinate effectively with internal and external stakeholders. Training and Stakeholder Management: Ability to guide users, deliver system training, manage stakeholder expectations, and maintain productive working relationships across multiple departments. Organisation and Time Management: Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, handle multiple requests, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced financial operations environment. Continuous Improvement Mindset: Proactive approach to identifying process inefficiencies, strengthening controls, improving reporting quality, and enhancing the overall employee and supplier experience. Preferred Qualifications: Professional certifications or additional coursework in Accounting, Finance, ERP systems, or Procure-to-Pay processes are advantageous. Remote Work Readiness: Ability to work effectively in a remote environment with reliable high-speed internet through a wired connection, such as fibre, cable, or DSL, and a suitable home workspace with minimal disruption. Benefits Remote Work Opportunity: Work remotely from India, with a suitable home-working environment and reliable internet connectivity. Equipment Support: Necessary computer equipment will be provided for the role. Professional Development: Opportunities to expand expertise in SAP Concur, SAP ERP, financial controls, and expense management operations. Career Growth: Exposure to Travel & Expense, Accounts Payable, Vendor Master Data, and broader Procure-to-Pay processes. Collaborative Environment: Work with cross-functional teams, business stakeholders, and external service providers in an international business setting. Skills Development: Opportunities to strengthen financial analysis, reporting, systems administration, stakeholder management, and process improvement skills. Inclusive Workplace: A commitment to equal employment opportunities, diversity, and a respectful working environment. Continuous Improvement Exposure: Opportunities to contribute to process optimisation, operational efficiency, and financial governance initiatives. review_queue.title: Specialist - Process Analytics - Claims & Underwriting 4B
review_queue.description: Accountabilities:: As a Process Analytics Specialist, you will manage portfolio analytics and catastrophe modeling activities, ensuring accurate exposure data, reliable modeling outputs, and timely delivery of analytical results. You will apply your understanding of reinsurance structures and risk modeling systems to investigate data variations and generate insights that support effective risk management. Manage Treaty and Facultative Submissions: Review and interpret treaty and facultative (FAC) submissions, ensuring relevant information is accurately captured and applied during portfolio modeling. Update Risk Modeling Accounts: Create, update, and model accounts within RMS RiskLink/AIR, incorporating the appropriate treaty information, terms, and conditions. Process Portfolio Exposure Data: Import and validate portfolio exposure summaries, run catastrophe models, and analyze results to identify relevant risk insights. Investigate Exposure Variations: Perform EDM reconciliations to determine the causes of differences between current and previous portfolio exposure results. Develop and Execute SQL Scripts: Create, modify, and run SQL scripts to support routine processing activities, data validation, reconciliation, and analytical workflows. Generate Risk Management Insights: Analyze client data and modeling outputs to identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities to improve risk assessment and portfolio management. Maintain Data Accuracy: Apply rigorous validation and analytical practices to ensure data integrity and reliable catastrophe modeling results. Meet Delivery Deadlines: Complete assigned tasks within established timelines while maintaining accuracy and productivity, particularly during monthly portfolio roll-up cycles. Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with colleagues and stakeholders to resolve analytical issues, share findings, and support efficient portfolio processing. Support Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to coaching and mentoring activities, helping colleagues strengthen their technical skills and understanding of portfolio analytics processes. Improve Operational Efficiency: Identify opportunities to refine day-to-day workflows and enhance the speed, quality, and consistency of analytical delivery. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines practical experience in portfolio analytics and catastrophe modeling with strong technical skills in risk modeling systems, SQL, and Excel. You should be comfortable interpreting complex insurance data, troubleshooting discrepancies, and delivering accurate results under pressure. Professional Experience: 3–5 years of experience in portfolio analytics, catastrophe modeling, or a closely related field. Catastrophe Modeling Expertise: Demonstrated experience with catastrophe models is essential, including the ability to interpret modeling outputs and assess portfolio exposure results. RMS RiskLink/AIR Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of RMS RiskLink/AIR and its backend data schema, including account modeling and portfolio processing. Treaty Modeling Knowledge: Understanding of reinsurance treaty modeling, treaty terms and conditions, and facultative submissions. SQL Skills: Proficiency in writing, modifying, and executing SQL queries and scripts to support data processing, reconciliation, and validation.
