review_queue.title: Amazon Catalog Specialist
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Manage Amazon product catalogs: Create, update, and maintain product listings across Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central, ensuring accurate product information, consistent content, and compliance with platform requirements. Troubleshoot catalog issues: Identify and resolve suppressed listings, detail page errors, stranded inventory, listing conflicts, and parent-child variation inconsistencies to maintain catalog health. Optimize listing content: Improve product titles, bullet points, descriptions, images, and other listing elements to strengthen search visibility, enhance the customer experience, and increase conversion potential. Manage product variations: Build, maintain, and audit parent-child relationships across catalogs, proactively identifying structural inconsistencies and correcting issues before they affect product discoverability or customer experience. Execute bulk catalog updates: Prepare, validate, and upload Amazon flat files and bulk templates to implement large-scale catalog changes efficiently while maintaining data accuracy. Coordinate with Amazon Support: Open, track, and manage support cases and work with Brand Registry to resolve listing conflicts, correct catalog information, and enforce brand content requirements. Conduct catalog audits: Regularly review product detail pages to identify content gaps, compliance risks, optimization opportunities, and inconsistencies across product listings. Improve listing performance: Plan and execute A/B tests on product content, analyze results, and implement data-driven changes to improve listing effectiveness. Conduct product and market research: Use Amazon Product Opportunity Explorer to assess keywords, niches, competitor activity, product features, customer reviews, and return-related insights to inform catalog optimization. Monitor organic ranking performance: Use Smart Scout and other approved research tools to evaluate keyword rankings and measure the impact of listing changes. Support promotional campaigns: Execute Amazon promotional campaigns and monitor their effects on product visibility and performance. Maintain reporting and documentation: Update sales trackers, catalog health reports, internal spreadsheets, and client-facing records to communicate progress, optimization results, and outstanding issues. Manage multiple catalogs independently: Handle catalogs of varying sizes, including those containing hundreds or thousands of SKUs, prioritize tasks effectively, and complete assignments accurately within agreed deadlines. Communicate and escalate effectively: Document issues and solutions clearly, provide timely updates, and seek clarification or escalate complex problems when necessary. Meet agreed service deliverables: Perform all assigned services professionally and in accordance with the written scope of work, agreed timelines, and applicable client requirements. Requirements: Amazon platform experience: At least one year of hands-on experience with Amazon Vendor Central and at least one year with Amazon Seller Central. Catalog management expertise: Proven experience troubleshooting Amazon listing issues, managing product detail pages, resolving suppressed listings, and maintaining accurate catalog structures. Bulk upload proficiency: Practical experience preparing and uploading Amazon flat files, using bulk templates, and implementing large-scale catalog updates with a high degree of accuracy. Variation management: Strong understanding of parent-child relationships, variation themes, catalog structures, and common variation-related issues. Amazon support and compliance: Experience managing Amazon Support cases and working with Brand Registry, alongside a solid understanding of Amazon listing guidelines, content policies, and compliance requirements. Listing optimization and testing: Experience optimizing product content and conducting A/B tests, with the ability to interpret results and translate findings into actionable improvements. Research and analytics: Familiarity with Amazon Product Opportunity Explorer and the ability to analyze organic ranking performance, competitor activity, product features, customer reviews, and return-related insights. Reporting and productivity tools: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, along with Google Workspace tools such as Gmail, Tasks, Keep Notes, and other relevant productivity applications. Promotional campaign experience: Familiarity with Amazon promotional campaigns and the ability to assess their impact on product performance. Attention to detail: Strong organizational skills and the ability to maintain accurate product data across multiple listings, catalogs, and competing priorities. Independent execution: Ability to work from task lists, manage assignments without continuous supervision, meet deadlines, and recognize when additional guidance is required. Communication skills: Clear written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to document catalog issues, explain solutions, and provide timely progress updates. human_review.title: Sales Operations Analyst
human_review.description: Accountabilities: Design, build, and maintain Salesforce reports, custom report types, dashboards, filters, and scheduled reporting. Develop advanced reporting solutions, including joined reports, complex filters, and multidimensional data analysis. Monitor and report on pipeline performance, forecasting accuracy, renewals, sales productivity, conversion rates, and revenue KPIs. Analyze sales trends, funnel performance, and forecast attainment to identify opportunities and recommend improvements. Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate reporting needs into scalable, reliable Salesforce solutions. Maintain data integrity across Salesforce Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, and Forecasting objects. Conduct regular data audits, investigate discrepancies, and improve the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of reporting. Establish and promote CRM data governance standards and best practices. Support forecasting, pipeline management, territory planning, quota management, and other sales operations initiatives. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance teams to align reporting frameworks, definitions, and performance metrics. Identify opportunities to streamline reporting workflows and continuously improve sales operations processes. Requirements Proven experience in Salesforce Reporting, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, CRM Analytics, or a related analytical role. Advanced hands-on expertise in creating and managing Salesforce reports, custom report types, dashboards, joined reports, scheduled reports, and complex reporting filters. Strong understanding of Salesforce data structures, standard objects, relationships, and reporting capabilities. Experience supporting sales forecasting, pipeline analysis, and performance reporting. Advanced Excel skills, including data analysis, data manipulation, and reporting. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex information into meaningful business insights. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to gather requirements and collaborate across multiple teams. High attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy, consistency, and quality. Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and contribute effectively in a collaborative environment. Desirable qualifications and experience: Familiarity with SQL and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Exposure to SaaS revenue metrics, forecasting methodologies, and go-to-market (GTM) operations. Experience supporting sales compensation, territory planning, or quota-setting initiatives. Salesforce certifications that demonstrate relevant platform or reporting expertise. Candidates who meet most, but not necessarily all, of these requirements are encouraged to apply. A willingness to learn, develop new skills, and contribute to the team is highly valued. Benefits Flexible working options: Access to flexibility arrangements that may include adjusted hours, staggered shifts, part-time schedules, and hybrid or remote work, depending on role requirements and individual circumstances. Learning and development: Opportunities to build professional skills, expand expertise, and support long-term career growth. Inclusive workplace: A welcoming, respectful, and supportive environment that values different perspectives and backgrounds. Work-life balance: Flexibility options designed to support personal commitments and individual needs. Community involvement: Opportunities to give back through volunteer initiatives, including dedicated volunteering leave. human_review.description: Accountabilities:: Create and maintain accurate, up-to-date purchase order trackers for merchants, including order status and retailer-specific information. Coordinate outbound shipments by working with fulfillment center operations teams, transportation providers, and brokers to ensure timely purchase order pickups. Prepare accurate, compliant bills of lading (BOLs) in accordance with retailer requirements and GS1 standards. Generate retailer-specific packing slips, shipping labels, carton labels, and pallet labels when required. Schedule dock appointments and coordinate shipment logistics to meet retailer delivery windows. Provide the Retail Compliance team with supporting documentation for retailer chargebacks to assist with investigations and disputes. Submit accurate shipment notices to retailers and follow established processes to prevent errors and delays. Monitor error-reporting tools, investigate operational or system defects, and escalate technical issues to the appropriate internal teams. Follow standard operating procedures for retailer routing, transportation management systems (TMS), and shipment scheduling requirements. Collaborate with on-site B2B leads to ensure purchase orders meet shipment deadlines and operational questions are resolved promptly. Build effective working relationships with Implementation, Product, Operations, Supply Chain Innovation, and Merchant Success teams to improve business outcomes. Escalate urgent issues in a timely manner, prioritizing merchant satisfaction and minimizing operational disruption. Create paid service request tickets when necessary to ensure additional services are appropriately billed. Participate in operational stand-up meetings with high-volume B2B sites, communicate recurring defects, and support continuous improvement initiatives. Follow procedures that protect product safety, quality, legality, and integrity throughout handling, storage, and distribution. Maintain accurate records to support product traceability, report concerns about product condition, and contribute to a culture of safety and operational excellence. Perform additional duties as assigned by the Success Operations Manager. Requirements: At least 1 year of experience in operations, business support, or backend coordination involving multiple departments. Strong written and spoken English communication skills, with the confidence to communicate clearly and professionally with merchants and internal stakeholders. Working knowledge of Microsoft Word and Microsoft Excel, including the ability to manage spreadsheets accurately and organize operational data. Comfort navigating online systems and internet-based tools to manage information, documentation, and shipment workflows. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks, competing priorities, and time-sensitive deadlines. Excellent attention to detail when preparing purchase order records, shipment documentation, labels, and compliance-related information. Ability to follow established instructions, standard operating procedures, and retailer-specific requirements consistently. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build effective working relationships with customers, transportation partners, and internal teams. A proactive approach to problem-solving, including recognizing errors, investigating issues, and escalating concerns when needed. A sense of ownership, accountability, and commitment to accurate work and positive merchant experiences. Willingness and ability to work the permanent US-support shift of 7:30 PM to 4:30 AM IST. Adaptability and a willingness to learn in a fast-paced, collaborative, results-oriented environment. Benefits: Remote work: Work from home in India, with a work-from-home allowance. Medical coverage: Medical, term life, and accidental insurance. Leave entitlement: 12 days of casual and sick leave combined. Earned leave: 15 days of earned leave. Public holidays: 12 public holidays. Parental support: Generous maternity and paternity leave. Well-being: A quarterly wellness day to support work-life balance. human_review.title: Project Management Associate
human_review.description: Accountabilities:: As a Project Management Associate, you will support end-to-end project delivery by managing data workflows, maintaining reporting accuracy, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure successful customer implementations. Your responsibilities will include: Data Analysis and Excel-Based Calculations: Process raw AI-generated outputs and transform them into accurate, customer-ready insights using advanced Excel functions, including VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, conditional logic, and complex formulas. Dataset Management: Analyze, organize, and reconcile large, multi-sheet datasets containing quantitative performance metrics and qualitative store execution information. ROI Analysis and Reporting: Translate project delivery metrics into measurable return-on-investment figures by applying business logic and validating calculations. Project Operations and Onboarding: Take ownership of assigned tasks within customer onboarding, ensuring data feeds, reporting processes, and operational requirements are completed accurately and on time. Task and Deadline Management: Coordinate multiple project components simultaneously, prioritize competing responsibilities, and meet deadlines across different customer engagements. Operational Ownership: Independently manage defined project activities from initiation through completion, ensuring reliable execution within your area of responsibility. Quality Assurance: Maintain rigorous quality control over datasets, calculations, and reports to ensure accuracy, consistency, and data integrity before sharing results with customers. Problem-Solving and Process Improvement: Identify potential roadblocks in data processing workflows, investigate operational issues, and proactively recommend solutions before problems escalate. Product Knowledge and Implementation Support: Develop a strong understanding of the product to troubleshoot operational challenges and support tailored solutions for customer-specific requirements. Cross-Functional Coordination: Work with Data Operations, Engineering, and Project Managers to resolve data issues, coordinate information flow, and keep projects progressing efficiently. Presentations and Stakeholder Communication: Help prepare professional, customer-facing presentations that communicate analytical findings, project performance, and actionable insights. Support presentations to internal teams and, occasionally, customers. Requirements: The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and proactive, with strong Excel skills and a willingness to take responsibility for project outcomes. The following qualifications and capabilities are expected: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including lookup functions, pivot tables, conditional logic, and the ability to build, troubleshoot, and maintain complex calculation models. Ability to work confidently with large datasets containing both numerical metrics and descriptive information, using Excel to manipulate, reconcile, and synthesize data. A high level of personal accountability, with a commitment to delivering accurate, reliable work within agreed deadlines. A proactive, action-oriented mindset, including the ability to identify process improvements, ask clarifying questions, and move tasks forward independently. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and develop practical solutions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain findings clearly and collaborate with different teams. Good organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Adaptability, enthusiasm for technology, and eagerness to learn new tools and processes. A degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Data Science, or a related field is preferred. A project management certification, or current enrollment in a relevant certification program, is an advantage. Previous experience demonstrating initiative and ownership through internships, academic projects, extracurricular activities, or professional responsibilities is beneficial. Familiarity with business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Zoho Analytics is helpful. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement. Full-time employment with an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in AI-powered retail technology. Practical exposure to project management, customer success, data analytics, and business intelligence. Opportunities to develop advanced Excel skills and gain experience with reporting and analytical tools. Cross-functional collaboration with Data Operations, Engineering, and project delivery teams. Opportunities to take ownership of meaningful projects and develop problem-solving and stakeholder management skills. Exposure to international customers and customer-facing project delivery. Create and manage audience lists, segmentation criteria, suppression lists, and automated marketing programs to ensure accurate and targeted campaign delivery. Build, maintain, and manage Salesforce campaigns, ensuring campaign structures and tracking mechanisms align with marketing objectives. Perform campaign quality assurance (QA) checks to verify content accuracy, audience selection, links, tracking parameters, and deployment readiness. Create and maintain email templates, forms, and landing pages to support campaign execution and audience conversion. Develop campaign performance reports and dashboards to monitor marketing effectiveness and communicate results to stakeholders. Analyze email engagement, campaign performance, and audience behavior to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. Track and report key performance indicators, including email opens, clicks, conversions, marketing-qualified leads (MQLs), and campaign influence. Support lead scoring, lead grading, and database health initiatives to improve lead quality and marketing data integrity. Provide data-driven recommendations to optimize campaign performance, strengthen audience engagement, and improve overall marketing effectiveness. Collaborate with relevant teams to align campaign execution, reporting practices, and performance objectives with broader business goals. Maintain high standards of accuracy, documentation, and operational efficiency throughout the campaign lifecycle. Requirements At least 3 years of professional experience in email marketing, marketing automation, campaign operations, or a related marketing discipline. Hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM, Pardot (Account Engagement), Marketing Cloud Next, or comparable email marketing and automation platforms. Proven ability to build, manage, test, and deploy email marketing campaigns from planning through execution and performance analysis. Strong understanding of audience segmentation, suppression lists, marketing automation workflows, and campaign management practices. Demonstrated reporting and analytical skills, including experience developing campaign performance reports and conducting trend analysis. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, with the ability to organize, analyze, and interpret marketing data accurately. Strong attention to detail and a quality-focused approach to campaign setup, data management, testing, and reporting. Ability to monitor key marketing metrics, interpret campaign results, and translate data into practical recommendations. Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and competing priorities. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and align marketing activities with business objectives. A proactive mindset, sound problem-solving abilities, and a commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence. Preferred qualifications: Familiarity with lead scoring and lead grading models used to assess prospect engagement and sales readiness. Experience with Power BI or similar business intelligence and reporting tools. Previous experience supporting business-to-business (B2B) marketing teams and campaigns. Ability to use performance data and audience insights to inform campaign strategy and improve marketing outcomes. Benefits Remote work arrangement: Full-time, work-from-home position based in India. verification_backlog.title: Associate Travel & Expense
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: Travel & Expense Platform Administration: Manage and maintain the SAP Concur Travel & Expense platform, including audit rule configuration, user administration, workflow maintenance, and routine system support to ensure reliable and efficient operations. Expense Auditing and Compliance: Review and audit employee expense reports in SAP Concur to verify compliance with travel policies, expense guidelines, and internal financial controls. Identify discrepancies, investigate exceptions, and ensure accurate and timely reimbursement processing. Corporate Card Administration: Manage the corporate card programme, including card issuance, ordering, deactivation, and monitoring of overdue balances. Ensure appropriate card usage and compliance with established policies and procedures. Workflow and Transaction Management: Monitor Concur workflows, including unassigned and unapproved transactions, and coordinate necessary follow-ups to ensure timely processing. Support month-end activities by preparing accrual reports and monitoring outstanding expenses. Vendor Master Data Management: Create, update, and maintain supplier records in SAP, ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of vendor information and supporting documentation. Supplier Documentation Validation: Review and validate supplier documentation, including tax forms, banking details, and other required records, before creating or modifying vendor master data. Issue Resolution and Stakeholder Support: Investigate and resolve complex travel expense, corporate card, and vendor data inquiries. Collaborate with employees, Accounts Payable, purchasing teams, business stakeholders, and external suppliers to address discrepancies and implement effective solutions. External Service Provider Coordination: Work with SAP Concur support teams, corporate card providers, and travel service partners to resolve technical issues, improve service delivery, and maintain efficient operational processes. Financial Reporting and Analysis: Prepare and analyse weekly and monthly operational reports for management. Monitor key performance indicators, identify trends, and provide accurate information to support decision-making and process improvement. Internal Controls and Financial Governance: Support the execution of internal controls across expense processing, corporate card administration, and vendor master maintenance. Maintain appropriate documentation and ensure adherence to financial governance requirements. Employee Training and Guidance: Provide training and onboarding support for new employees using the expense management platform. Assist existing employees with system queries, expense policies, and workflow-related questions. Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve expense management, supplier data maintenance, reporting accuracy, and workflow efficiency. Support standardisation and continuous improvement initiatives across finance operations. Requirements Education: A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline. Professional Experience: Ideally 5–8 years of relevant experience in Travel & Expense management, Accounts Payable, Vendor Master Data, Finance Operations, or Procure-to-Pay processes, preferably within a shared services centre or multinational organisation. verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities:: Payroll Inbox and Communication Support: Monitor the India Payroll inbox, organize incoming requests, categorize emails, and direct queries to the appropriate team members. Prepare routine acknowledgements and status updates for review before distribution. Ticket Tracking and Follow-up: Record, monitor, and update payroll-related tickets and requests, ensuring information remains accurate and current. Follow up with relevant stakeholders on outstanding items and identify recurring queries that could be addressed through improved FAQs or self-service resources. Data Management and Reporting: Assist with preparing, formatting, and updating Excel-based reports and trackers. Monitor ticket volumes, request categories, and turnaround times while supporting payroll-related data entry, validation, and information clean-up. Process Documentation and Knowledge Management: Help create and maintain checklists, quick-reference guides, FAQs, and internal process documentation. Keep shared files and knowledge repositories organized, accurate, and up to date. AI and Process Improvement: Explore practical applications of AI-powered tools for administrative tasks, including drafting, summarizing, and organizing information. Share suggestions and contribute to small initiatives aimed at improving efficiency and standardizing workflows. Coordination and Administrative Support: Maintain team trackers, monitor action items, and coordinate with stakeholders across Payroll, People Operations, IT, and other departments. Provide day-to-day administrative assistance and maintain a training log with regular supervisor reviews. Learning and Development: Participate in structured onboarding, training activities, and regular progress reviews. Complete assigned tasks under the supervision of the Payroll Manager or designated team members, incorporating feedback and following established procedures. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in any discipline, such as B.Com, BBA, BA, or B.Sc. Recent graduates are encouraged to apply. No previous payroll experience is required; structured training and ongoing guidance will be provided. Strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accuracy when handling information and performing administrative tasks. Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with colleagues and internal stakeholders. Basic to intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, with an interest in developing spreadsheet and reporting skills. Comfort working with data, spreadsheets, trackers, and routine reports. Strong organizational and time-management skills, including the ability to manage follow-ups and complete assigned tasks within deadlines. Ability to handle confidential employee and payroll information with discretion and professionalism. Interest in learning how AI-powered tools can support administrative processes and improve workplace efficiency. A proactive, curious, and adaptable mindset, with a willingness to learn, accept feedback, and follow instructions. Ability to collaborate effectively with different teams while working in a remote environment. Genuine interest in developing a career in Payroll, Human Resources, Finance Operations, or related fields. Availability to work Monday to Friday, from 10:30 AM to 7:30 PM India Standard Time. Benefits: Monthly stipend: INR 35,000 throughout the six-month apprenticeship. Work arrangement: Fully remote opportunity, available to candidates based in India. Programme duration: Six-month structured apprenticeship starting in November 2026. Practical experience: Hands-on exposure to payroll operations, employee queries, ticket management, reporting, and administrative processes. Structured training: Comprehensive onboarding covering payroll processes, internal tools, and ticket-handling procedures. Dedicated supervision: Direct guidance and regular work reviews from an assigned Payroll Manager. Professional development: Practical training in Excel, data management, reporting, and AI-powered administrative tools. Continuous feedback: Regular check-ins, progress reviews, and a structured training plan to support learning and development. Completion certificate: Receive a certificate of completion to showcase your experience and strengthen your professional profile. Career development opportunities: Build foundational skills relevant to future positions such as Payroll Executive, Payroll Analyst, Payroll Specialist, Compliance Analyst, HRIS Analyst, Compensation and Benefits Analyst, or Finance Operations professional. verification_backlog.title: Specialist - Process Analytics - Claims & Underwriting 4B
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities:: As a Process Analytics Specialist, you will manage portfolio analytics and catastrophe modeling activities, ensuring accurate exposure data, reliable modeling outputs, and timely delivery of analytical results. You will apply your understanding of reinsurance structures and risk modeling systems to investigate data variations and generate insights that support effective risk management. Manage Treaty and Facultative Submissions: Review and interpret treaty and facultative (FAC) submissions, ensuring relevant information is accurately captured and applied during portfolio modeling. Update Risk Modeling Accounts: Create, update, and model accounts within RMS RiskLink/AIR, incorporating the appropriate treaty information, terms, and conditions. Process Portfolio Exposure Data: Import and validate portfolio exposure summaries, run catastrophe models, and analyze results to identify relevant risk insights. Investigate Exposure Variations: Perform EDM reconciliations to determine the causes of differences between current and previous portfolio exposure results. Develop and Execute SQL Scripts: Create, modify, and run SQL scripts to support routine processing activities, data validation, reconciliation, and analytical workflows. Generate Risk Management Insights: Analyze client data and modeling outputs to identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities to improve risk assessment and portfolio management. Maintain Data Accuracy: Apply rigorous validation and analytical practices to ensure data integrity and reliable catastrophe modeling results. Meet Delivery Deadlines: Complete assigned tasks within established timelines while maintaining accuracy and productivity, particularly during monthly portfolio roll-up cycles. Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with colleagues and stakeholders to resolve analytical issues, share findings, and support efficient portfolio processing. Support Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to coaching and mentoring activities, helping colleagues strengthen their technical skills and understanding of portfolio analytics processes. Improve Operational Efficiency: Identify opportunities to refine day-to-day workflows and enhance the speed, quality, and consistency of analytical delivery. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines practical experience in portfolio analytics and catastrophe modeling with strong technical skills in risk modeling systems, SQL, and Excel. You should be comfortable interpreting complex insurance data, troubleshooting discrepancies, and delivering accurate results under pressure. Professional Experience: 3–5 years of experience in portfolio analytics, catastrophe modeling, or a closely related field. Catastrophe Modeling Expertise: Demonstrated experience with catastrophe models is essential, including the ability to interpret modeling outputs and assess portfolio exposure results. RMS RiskLink/AIR Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of RMS RiskLink/AIR and its backend data schema, including account modeling and portfolio processing. Treaty Modeling Knowledge: Understanding of reinsurance treaty modeling, treaty terms and conditions, and facultative submissions. SQL Skills: Proficiency in writing, modifying, and executing SQL queries and scripts to support data processing, reconciliation, and validation. Microsoft Excel Expertise: Advanced Excel skills, including familiarity with macros and spreadsheet-based analysis. Data Reconciliation and Analysis: Strong analytical capabilities and attention to detail, with the ability to investigate data discrepancies and identify the underlying causes of exposure variations. Academic Qualifications: A bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Computer Science, or Statistics, or a master's degree in Data Science, is relevant to the role. Time Management: Ability to prioritize workloads, deliver time-sensitive tasks, and maintain quality during demanding monthly portfolio roll-up cycles. Problem-Solving Skills: Strong critical thinking and troubleshooting abilities, with a proactive approach to resolving technical and data-related challenges. Communication Skills: Good written and verbal English communication skills, with an indicated proficiency level of B1 or intermediate. Teamwork and Motivation: Ability to collaborate effectively, demonstrate initiative, and maintain a high level of motivation in a fast-paced environment. Execution and Adaptability: Strong execution speed, flexibility, and the ability to manage work pressure while meeting operational requirements. Coaching and Mentoring: Ability to share knowledge and support the development of other team members. Relevant Certifications: Insurance-related certifications may be beneficial, although specific certifications are not clearly established as mandatory in the posting. Benefits: Remote Work: Fully remote position based in India. Flexible Schedule: Flex-time working arrangements aligned with business requirements. Career Development: Opportunities to expand technical expertise and progress professionally through hands-on experience and challenging assignments. Learning and Mentorship: Access to learning opportunities, mentoring, and professional development. Meaningful Business Impact: Contribute to risk analytics and catastrophe modeling activities that support major enterprise clients. Advanced Technology Exposure: Work with specialized catastrophe modeling systems, SQL, Excel, and data analytics processes. Collaborative Culture: Join a team-oriented environment that values innovation, integrity, curiosity, inclusion, and continuous improvement. Inclusive Workplace: Equal employment opportunity and a commitment to a respectful, diverse working environment. Compensation: No specific salary range or detailed benefits package was provided in the job description. verification_backlog.title: Amazon Catalog Specialist
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: Manage Amazon product catalogs: Create, update, and maintain product listings across Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central, ensuring accurate product information, consistent content, and compliance with platform requirements. Troubleshoot catalog issues: Identify and resolve suppressed listings, detail page errors, stranded inventory, listing conflicts, and parent-child variation inconsistencies to maintain catalog health. Optimize listing content: Improve product titles, bullet points, descriptions, images, and other listing elements to strengthen search visibility, enhance the customer experience, and increase conversion potential. Manage product variations: Build, maintain, and audit parent-child relationships across catalogs, proactively identifying structural inconsistencies and correcting issues before they affect product discoverability or customer experience. Execute bulk catalog updates: Prepare, validate, and upload Amazon flat files and bulk templates to implement large-scale catalog changes efficiently while maintaining data accuracy. Coordinate with Amazon Support: Open, track, and manage support cases and work with Brand Registry to resolve listing conflicts, correct catalog information, and enforce brand content requirements. Conduct catalog audits: Regularly review product detail pages to identify content gaps, compliance risks, optimization opportunities, and inconsistencies across product listings. Improve listing performance: Plan and execute A/B tests on product content, analyze results, and implement data-driven changes to improve listing effectiveness. Conduct product and market research: Use Amazon Product Opportunity Explorer to assess keywords, niches, competitor activity, product features, customer reviews, and return-related insights to inform catalog optimization. Monitor organic ranking performance: Use Smart Scout and other approved research tools to evaluate keyword rankings and measure the impact of listing changes. Support promotional campaigns: Execute Amazon promotional campaigns and monitor their effects on product visibility and performance. Maintain reporting and documentation: Update sales trackers, catalog health reports, internal spreadsheets, and client-facing records to communicate progress, optimization results, and outstanding issues. Manage multiple catalogs independently: Handle catalogs of varying sizes, including those containing hundreds or thousands of SKUs, prioritize tasks effectively, and complete assignments accurately within agreed deadlines. Communicate and escalate effectively: Document issues and solutions clearly, provide timely updates, and seek clarification or escalate complex problems when necessary. Meet agreed service deliverables: Perform all assigned services professionally and in accordance with the written scope of work, agreed timelines, and applicable client requirements. Requirements: Amazon platform experience: At least one year of hands-on experience with Amazon Vendor Central and at least one year with Amazon Seller Central. Catalog management expertise: Proven experience troubleshooting Amazon listing issues, managing product detail pages, resolving suppressed listings, and maintaining accurate catalog structures. Bulk upload proficiency: Practical experience preparing and uploading Amazon flat files, using bulk templates, and implementing large-scale catalog updates with a high degree of accuracy. Variation management: Strong understanding of parent-child relationships, variation themes, catalog structures, and common variation-related issues. Amazon support and compliance: Experience managing Amazon Support cases and working with Brand Registry, alongside a solid understanding of Amazon listing guidelines, content policies, and compliance requirements. Listing optimization and testing: Experience optimizing product content and conducting A/B tests, with the ability to interpret results and translate findings into actionable improvements. Research and analytics: Familiarity with Amazon Product Opportunity Explorer and the ability to analyze organic ranking performance, competitor activity, product features, customer reviews, and return-related insights. Reporting and productivity tools: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, along with Google Workspace tools such as Gmail, Tasks, Keep Notes, and other relevant productivity applications. Promotional campaign experience: Familiarity with Amazon promotional campaigns and the ability to assess their impact on product performance. Attention to detail: Strong organizational skills and the ability to maintain accurate product data across multiple listings, catalogs, and competing priorities. Independent execution: Ability to work from task lists, manage assignments without continuous supervision, meet deadlines, and recognize when additional guidance is required. Communication skills: Clear written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to document catalog issues, explain solutions, and provide timely progress updates. Preferred experience: Background in catalog audits, SEO-driven listing optimization, agency or multi-brand environments, and managing multiple client catalogs. Additional preferred tools: Experience with Smart Scout for product and organic ranking analysis, Keepa for product and Buy Box monitoring, and research tools that support large-scale Amazon catalog optimization. Professional approach: A proactive, analytical, and solutions-oriented mindset, with the ability to adapt to different client requirements and product volumes. Work arrangement and schedule: Remote independent contractor opportunity open to candidates based in Poland. Contracted workload of approximately 20 hours per week . Standard schedule: Monday through Friday, from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM Eastern Time (ET) , subject to mutual agreement and scheduling requirements. One contractor will be assigned to the engagement. English is the required working language. A neutral accent is preferred, but no gender preference applies. The assigned contact person and reporting arrangements will be confirmed during the engagement process. Benefits: Competitive rates: Compensation based on the terms of the independent contractor engagement. Weekly payments: Regular weekly payment processing through the contracting platform, according to the agreed terms. Flexible remote work: Work remotely while supporting international e-commerce clients. Part-time commitment: A defined 20-hour weekly schedule that may offer flexibility alongside other professional commitments. Training and upskilling: Access to free training opportunities designed to develop professional capabilities and expand e-commerce expertise. Ongoing support: Guidance and assistance throughout the engagement to help contractors complete assignments successfully. Professional community: Access to a supportive community of virtual assistants and independent professionals. Additional opportunities: Exposure to a range of potential client engagements and e-commerce-related roles, depending on availability and qualifications. International experience: The opportunity to strengthen Amazon marketplace expertise while working with clients in global markets. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company.
